questions.question: What is the primary benefit of applying box-sizing: border-box to all elements?
options: It rounds the corners of borders
It includes padding and border within the declared width and height, preventing layout overflow
It removes all external margins automatically
questions.hint: Padding and borders are included within the element's width.
questions.explanation: box-sizing: border-box ensures declared dimensions encompass padding and borders, avoiding unexpected layout expansion.

questions.question: Which layer of the CSS box model is the outermost transparent layer separating adjacent elements?
questions.explanation: The margin is the outermost layer of the box model that creates space around elements outside the border.

questions.question: What happens when an h1 with margin-bottom: 30px is followed immediately by a p with margin-top: 20px in normal flow?
options: The vertical space between them is 50px
The margins collapse, resulting in a single 30px vertical gap
The browser generates a CSS parsing error
questions.hint: Vertical margin collapsing merges to the largest value.
questions.explanation: Adjacent vertical block margins collapse into a single space equal to the maximum margin (30px).

questions.question: In the shorthand padding: 10px 20px 30px 40px;, which value represents the left padding?
questions.explanation: 4-value shorthand follows a clockwise sequence: Top (10px), Right (20px), Bottom (30px), Left (40px).

questions.question: How do you horizontally center a block-level element with a fixed width within its parent container?
questions.explanation: margin: 0 auto (or margin-inline: auto) evenly distributes available horizontal space, centering block elements.
